report.js.description: Build four-level structures from flat facts for whoami output

selfeval_schemas.js.name: selfeval_schemas

selfeval_handler.js.name: selfeval_handler
selfeval_handler.js.description: Selfeval runner for handler facet - validates index.js exports function

selfeval_reqs.js.name: selfeval_reqs

selfeval_children.js.name: selfeval_children

selfeval_final.js.name: selfeval_final
